tool.name: Biomni: Design Golden Gate Oligos
tool.description: Design oligos for Golden Gate assembly by identifying backbone overhangs
tool.help:
**Biomni: Design Golden Gate Oligos**
Design oligos for Golden Gate assembly by identifying backbone overhangs and creating matching insert oligos.
Args: backbone_sequence (str): The plasmid/backbone sequence insert_sequence (str): Sequence to be inserted enzyme_name (str): Type IIS restriction enzyme to be used is_circular (bool): Whether the backbone is circular (default: True)
Returns: Dict: Dictionary containing overhang information and designed oligos
**Domain**: molecular_biology **Function**: design_golden_gate_oligos
